request.subject: UNIT:ICE_FOLK:CATAPULT

layers.text: Recolour only the shadows of the snow: every cool blue and blue-grey shadow tone on the body, arms, legs and head becomes a warm light taupe grey, colour #c4b8a6, darker #a0937f in the deepest folds, so no snow is blue or grey-blue. Keep the ivory white lit snow, the bright blue ice crystals, the dark slate boulder, the black eyes and mouth, the shapes, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
